en: An object falling on the Moon accelerates at 1.6 meters per second squared, which is about one-sixth of Earth's 9.8 meters per second squared.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second, taking exactly 8 minutes and 20 seconds to cross the 150 million kilometers from the Sun to Earth.
Sound travels through water at 1,480 meters per second, which is more than four times faster than its speed of 343 meters per second in air.
A standard Philippine household outlet supplies 230 volts of electricity, which is more than double the 110 volts used in standard North American outlets.
A strong neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight, making it the strongest type of permanent magnet commercially available.
The Sun's core reaches a massive 15 million degrees Celsius, while its visible surface is much cooler at approximately 5,500 degrees Celsius.
A block and tackle pulley system with four supporting rope segments multiplies your input pulling force by exactly four, making heavy loads easier to lift.
The coefficient of friction for ice sliding on ice is about 0.03, making it roughly 100 times slipperier than rubber tires on dry concrete.
If you double the speed of a moving car, its kinetic energy increases by four times, requiring four times the distance to brake safely.
A 2-kilogram boulder resting on a 10-meter high cliff has exactly 196 joules of gravitational potential energy relative to the ground below.
One kilogram of human body fat stores about 37 million joules of chemical energy, enough to power a 100-watt lightbulb continuously for over four days.
A ramp with a length of 10 meters and a height of 2 meters provides a mechanical advantage of 5, reducing the needed lifting force by five times.
